report_summary: The report gives a useful task-specific Montana signal narrative with test-noise correction and explicit uncertainty about scores, operator identity and XSS success. It also infers one continuous operation and ephemeral session counts from labels/prefixes, confuses all page keys with new creations, and treats missing deletion matches as survivors. Cleanup and session-termination conclusions are stronger than the recorded observations.
